macros.name: columnbreak
macros.doc: From version 1.9 onwards \columnbreak accepts an optional argument (just like \pagebreak) in which you can specify the desirability to break the column at that point: supported values are 0 (slightly desirable) to 4 (forced).

macros.name: columnseprulecolor
macros.doc: The color of the rules separating the columns can be specified through \columnseprulecolor.

macros.name: flushcolumns
macros.doc: The default is \flushcolumns, so TeX will normally try to make both the top and bottom baselines of all columns align.

macros.name: premulticols
macros.doc: If the space is less than \premulticols, a new page is started.
